text:
anya: Quick sync — changelog cutoff is EOD Thu (48 hrs). Need final ownership + sample app dependency status so we can cut release notes. Tagging owners: @ben @carmen @frida. Can each confirm: sample app build, docs PR, and any blocking infra deps?

release-bot: changelog-lock engaged for channel devex :lock: Cutoff = 2026-03-19T23:59Z

ben: Sample app `starter-node` is green except one env-var wrinkle in CI (missing REDWOOD_API_URL). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-starter/pull/42. I can patch today, ETA 3pm PT.

carmen: Docs PR merged to main but need to update the quickstart snippet for the new client API call shape. I'll push a tiny follow-up change — probably <30m.

frida: SDK release note: we still need the mac wheels published for v1.4.2 — build queued but blocked by packaging infra flakiness. Filing infra ticket now. If mac wheels are late, can we call out in the changelog that mac builds will follow?

mike: Can infra/eng triage packaging blocker? Frida says it's the packaging VM hitting timeouts during wheel build (pip wheel step).

eric: I'll run a focused job to reproduce the timeout at 14:00 PT and share logs. @frida do you have the exact failing command?

frida: yeah, command in CI: ```bash
python -m pip wheel --no-binary=:all: -w dist ./
```
It fails with "timed out waiting for build" on mac-latest image.

qa-bot: reminder: smoke test batch scheduled 2026-03-19 00:00 UTC. Add any extra endpoints to the config by 2026-03-18 23:00 UTC.

anya: Ownership summary I have so far:
- starter-node sample: ben (patch ETA 3pm PT)
- quickstart docs snippet: carmen (inflight)
- sdk wheels: frida (packaging ticket filed)
- smoke/run: eric + qa-team (eric to run repro at 14:00 PT)

anya: Action items: please react with :white_check_mark: when your item is cleared OR post ETA if delayed. We want all :white_check_mark: by cutoff or we add a follow-up note in the changelog.

ben: Patch merged at 15:08 PT. CI rerun succeeded. :white_check_mark:

carmen: pushed small docs snippet update. Live in main. :white_check_mark:

frida: packaging ticket RED-1234 created: https://redwood-internal/RED-1234. Infra investigating, ETA unknown. If not resolved by cutoff, add note about mac wheel follow-up. :eyes:

eric: reproduced timeout locally, attaching gist with logs: https://gist.github.com/eric/packagelog. Trying a retry with increased timeout now.

mike: For changelog text, propose this blurb for SDK section: "macOS wheel publication delayed; users can pip-install from source or use linux wheels. mac wheels to follow. See RED-1234." + short owner note. OK with that?

anya: That wording sounds good. We'll include that if frida's blocker isn't cleared by 23:59Z.

frida: infra patched VM timeout, retried build at 18:12 PT — succeeded. wheels uploaded. :rocket: :white_check_mark:

release-bot: changelog pre-cut prepared. Ready to review: https://eng.redwood-inference/changelogs/1.4.2/draft

mike: Quick checklist before cut (I ran through):
- [x] docs PR merged
- [x] starter-node sample green
- [x] SDK wheels published
- [x] smoke tests scheduled
- [ ] final sanity run (eric)

eric: sanity run complete at 20:41 PT — no regressions detected. :white_check_mark:

anya: Great — will cut changelog at 23:59Z unless any objections. If you want a blurb added, ping me now. Thanks for quick turn on the packaging fix everyone.

ben: :thumbsup:

carmen: :thumbsup:

frida: :thumbsup:

mike: Cut requested and approved. Good job team.

release-bot: changelog cut complete. Release notes posted and draft closed. :tada:

anya: Closing thread — will follow up with release announcement timing.
